proposed_statement_changes.reason: The vacuous-drift reduction is valid after adding the precise condition that the adaptive design does not use omitted off-window outcomes. Under the frozen arbitrary history-adaptive design, changing an off-window outcome can change later propensities and hence the law of the retained concurrent record, so zero-imputation or conditional averaging does not preserve the experiment uniformly over schedules. The original unconditional reduction therefore asserts a schedule-uniform garbling that the primitives do not provide. The final concurrent claim is also narrowed to the exact block-score identity because the frozen predictions are only full-history measurable and may themselves use omitted outcomes. The zero-drift nondegeneracy premise is quantified schedule by schedule; the finite assignment tree and propensity floor then supply the uniform coefficient bound needed for interiority.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The narrowed claim directly uses the sequential design, support and propensity-floor assumptions, the schedule family, and the borrowing-estimator formula; this replacement records the complete dependency and free-symbol closure while leaving proof text in the proofs channel.

proposed.justification: The endpoint reductions prevent the optimizer from laundering either unrestricted pooling or automatic rejection of valid borrowing.
proposed.gap: MarschnerSchou2024 Definitions 2.1--2.3 distinguish randomized cohorts, concurrent controls, nonconcurrent controls, and contemporaneous controls, but do not give a fixed-schedule minimax experiment or prove that unrestricted drift makes the full-record and concurrent-only all-kernel values equal.
proposed.consumer: The endpoints provide validation cases for the NCC implementation and ACTT sensitivity plots.
